source: User clarification in this work session

datasets.origin: Augmented/simulated from charging.csv, confirmed by user

datasets.independentTrainingExamples: At most 77 trips, not 77108 independent sessions

trainingFindings: External scripts/train_charging_time.py derives avg_charge_rate from duration_min, the target; existing quality metrics cannot establish deployment quality.
External script uses test set for early stopping/model selection; an untouched grouped chronological holdout is still required.
Trip script calls measured max/mean speed and acceleration pre-trip features, but those values are not known before a future trip without explicit user inputs/forecasts.
Synthetic descendants of an original session must remain in the same split; independent measured test must not use these descendants.
Six charging examples cannot satisfy minimum 20 independent held-out test cases plus disjoint train/validation.
decision: Keep mobile predictions unavailable until task-specific artifact and independent measured evaluation pass. Synthetic-only research is not release certification.
